messages:
Rae: quick note 1: ran a micro bring-up for 'horizon-lite-9b' int6 vs int8 over 3 slices (chat/search/summary). short econ + ops takeaways below.

Jo: cool, sample sizes?

Rae: 250 samples per slice using onboard harness. top-line: infra cost per 1k tokens int8=$0.0115, int6=$0.0068 (~41% cheaper). latency p95 int8=115ms, int6=205ms on standard node. throughput -16% tokens/sec on int6.

Cam: what about quality regressions?

Rae: small but focused: chat QA mean -0.04 (5pt), search MRR -0.8% absolute, summary ROUGE-L -0.5. hallucination proxy +0.45% concentrated on numeric and date-heavy prompts. variance higher on multi-turns.

Priya: CI? noise?

Rae: 250 is modest. bootstrap CI: MRR +/-0.5, ROUGE +/-0.25. recommend 1k-sample shadow for search before any routing change.

Jo: ops plan? routing rules?

Rae: propose hybrid route: keep int8 for retrieval/billing/numeric-extract endpoints, int6 for low-stakes chat and short summaries. Canary: 48h with 1k shadow + live split (chat 5%, search 15%). rollback on MRR drop >0.5% or halluc proxy +1.0%. prompt mitigations: detect multi-step numeric patterns -> force int8; add numeric-check post-filter for summaries. also increase prefix cache TTL for long context to lower token repeat spend.

Cam: paste tiny routing mock?

Rae: pseudo: if meta.slice in ("retrieval","billing") -> model=horizon-lite-9b-int8 elif meta.slice=="chat" and est_tokens<1200 -> model=horizon-lite-9b-int6 else -> model=horizon-lite-9b-int8

Priya: GTN blurb?

Rae: "Int6 offers ~35-45% infra savings with modest, targeted quality regressions (numeric/retrieval-sensitive). Recommend targeted hybrid routing, 48h guarded canary, and prompt-level guards before broad rollout."

Jo: next actions: Rae run 1k search shadow, produce 1-page GTN summary, capture top failure prompts. DeployBot: schedule 5% chat canary after Rae uploads 1k results.

DeployBot: Canary queued: horizon-lite-9b-int6 chat route 5% start=2026-03-24T14:00Z. Monitors: MRR, latency_p95, hallucination_proxy.

Priya: nice concise plan. drop links when available. :thumbsup:
